Proves the phase clock + mood-grade wiring end-to-end: world_ready -> ui_mood_applied{inn,day} -> exactly 100 real actions (the dusk threshold, matching moods.json meta.phase_thresholds -- retuned 40->100) -> phase_changed{dusk} + ui_mood_applied{*,dusk} -> sleep at the bed -> phase_changed{day} + ui_mood_applied{inn,day}. No combat anywhere in the path (phase's PC-turn tick is proven by M7's own fold, not this script). Also proves the UI-ungraded claim: the journal opens/closes at the identity day grade with no visible interference (windowed screenshot is the real evidence -- see task-b1-report.md). Issue #80 (world reactivity wave) EXTENSION: the dusk crossing now also proves the ctx `phase` key's first dialogue consumer (Erin's dusk/night text_variant, live) before continuing on to a real NIGHT crossing and hungry_patron's `present_when` flip -- ABSENT at night (both sim-side, a real successful walk onto his now-open cell, and render-side, `ui_entities_rendered`'s inn sprite count dropping 16->15), PRESENT again once the sleep beat resets to day (both proofs reversed). GH#104 (follow-up to #80) EXTENSION: the night crossing above is reached via plain `move` actions only (no teleport/MAP_CHANGED anywhere yet at that point in the script) -- a `ui_entities_rendered{sprites:15}` wait right there proves world.gd's new `_reconcile_entity_presence` (hooked on PHASE_CHANGED) frees the ghosted visual LIVE, same-map, closing the same-map ghost `entity_present`'s doc comment used to disclose; the pre-existing teleport-based 16->15 proof right after is now a redundant cross-map re-confirmation of the same count, kept unmodified. No new fixture; still the same continuous day->dusk->night->day run.

steps._comment: The inn's two light anchors (hearth [2,1] + grill [3,2], both warm/flicker) are always spawned regardless of phase -- energy is what phase-gates their visibility, not existence -- so count==2 holds at EVERY rebuild of this map, day included. This is the honest headless tooth for the light layer per the plan's own note (energy is presentation state with no sim-side signal to assert on): event presence + count, not a visible-glow assertion -- the windowed dusk shot (task-b2-report.md) is what actually proves a light reads as lit. assert_event_logged (whole-run scan), NOT wait_for_event -- ui_lights_rendered fires inside world.gd's _rebuild_field, which runs BEFORE world_ready is emitted (same ordering class as work_loop's nested-autosave gotcha in CLAUDE.md), so by the time the world_ready wait above resolves the since-marker cursor has already passed it; a forward-only wait here would hang to timeout.

The inn's one ambience entry (dust_motes, rect:'all', phase [dusk,night]) is ALSO always spawned regardless of the current phase -- same emitter-always-exists/emitting-toggled-by-phase design as lights -- so emitters==1 holds at every rebuild, day included. Same since-marker reasoning as the ui_lights_rendered tooth above: assert_event_logged (whole-run scan), not wait_for_event.

steps._comment: a6 #206: 400 real actions (dusk_at doubled 200->400; lineage #62 doubled 100->200) via paced back-and-forth moves along inn row y=3, which is clear of every entity/blocked cell from x=1 to x=14 (only inn_door sits at [15,3], well outside this range) -- see CLAUDE.md's inn layout lock + skeleton_scene.json. (2,3)->right10->(12,3)->left10->(2,3), TWENTY round trips = 400 successful move_player calls (re-sized for a6 #206: dusk_at 200->400), zero blocked attempts, net displacement zero. Math: dusk_at is 400 (moods.json meta.phase_thresholds), so the 400th successful move crosses day->dusk exactly (before=399<400 day, after=400>=400 dusk). This route is SIZED to dusk_at and re-sizes with it -- see CLAUDE.md's phase-threshold change rule.

No second ui_lights_rendered is expected here -- that event only fires from world.gd's _rebuild_field pass (world_ready/map_changed), and this route never changes map across the dusk crossing, only phase. Light ENERGY (what actually goes from 0 at day to >0 at dusk) is presentation state atmosphere.gd owns directly and the sim never sees or emits -- there is no honest sim-observable event to assert energy>0 on. The real proof that the inn's hearth/grill are lit at dusk is a windowed screenshot read, same idiom as the identity-grade zero-visual-change proof above; see task-b2-report.md's dusk shot (a THROWAWAY floodplains script proves the visible glow at the campfire anchor specifically, since the inn route here never leaves day/dusk mood parity that a screenshot alone could show apart).

Continue on to a REAL night crossing (night_at=900, a6 #206). 25 more round trips of the same zero-net row y=3 walk (500 actions) -- comfortably clears 900 from wherever the Erin interlude left actions_since_sleep (movement/interact tick it, dialogue cursor navigation/confirm do not -- world.gd's _movement_gated() routes ALL input to the dialogue panel while Game.sim.dialogue != null, so the down/down/confirm sequence above cost nothing). Net displacement zero either way, so player_cell/actions_since_sleep stay predictable without needing the exact intermediate count.

GH#104 (follow-up to #80): THE SAME-MAP FLIP LEG. The player never left the inn to reach this night crossing -- every phase tick above came from plain `move` actions, no `teleport`/MAP_CHANGED anywhere in the script yet (grep confirms this is the first teleport below). Before this fix, world.gd's `_entity_visuals` only reconciled EXISTENCE on MAP_CHANGED, so hungry_patron's present_when{phase:[day,dusk]} flip at night would sim-correctly block his cell but leave his sprite ghosted on screen (and the render-side sprite count stuck at 16) until the player left and re-entered the inn. `_reconcile_entity_presence` (world.gd, hooked on PHASE_CHANGED) now frees his visual in place and re-emits `ui_entities_rendered` the SAME beat the phase_changed{night} wait above already resolved -- this wait_for_event only passes if that live, no-MAP_CHANGED re-render actually happened.

THE PRESENCE FLIP, absent half (issue #80 item 3): hungry_patron carries present_when{phase:[day,dusk]}, so at night WIGame.entity_present(hungry_patron) reads false. Teleport to (5,5) (directly above his cell, open ground at every phase) -- transition() emits MAP_CHANGED unconditionally even for a same-map teleport, forcing world.gd's _rebuild_field to re-resolve entity_present for every entity; this is now a REDUNDANT re-confirmation of the same 16->15 count the same-map leg above already proved live (kept as the pre-existing cross-map/sim-occupancy proof, unmodified).

The SIM-side proof, and the stronger one: hungry_patron's cell (5,6) is normally occupancy-blocked (entity_present gates is_cell_blocked) -- at night the move SUCCEEDS, landing the player ON his former cell. This is genuine structural absence (present_when's own contract), not merely a hidden sprite you could still walk into or talk to (visual_states' hidden -- deliberately NOT used here, see WIGame.entity_present's own doc comment).

== #359 THE LOOP, walked. Before this the clock was MONOTONE per waking -- night was terminal and a long waking simply sat in it until the player slept. It wraps now: cycle = 2*night_at (1800 at the shipped 400/900), day and night both dusk_at long (400), and the dusk band (500) is the transition on BOTH sides -- evening above, dawn below. Everything from here to the sleep leg is walked for real on the same clear y=3 row the dusk/night crossings used, with actions_since_sleep pinned at every edge, so a threshold retune fails this loudly instead of silently sitting in night. Clock reads 913 here (the presence-flip leg's own move landed it there); teleport back to the row's west end -- a teleport never ticks the clock.
913 + 380 = 1293, seven short of the dawn edge at night_at + dusk_at = 1300. Night is EXACTLY as long as day (400 actions, 900..1299) -- that equality is the issue's own ask.
The 1300th action is the dawn crossing: night ends, the SAME dusk band the evening used takes over.

And the consumers came with it: hungry_patron's present_when{phase:[day,dusk]} is met again at dawn WITHOUT a sleep, so world.gd's PHASE_CHANGED reconciler rebuilds him on the same map (17 -> 18 sprites, the night half's own count reversed).

1800 = 2 * night_at = the cycle. A new day opens with NO sleep -- the whole point of #359. once_per_waking is untouched by this (it keys on SLEEP, never on phase), and `times_slept` is still 0 at this line.

#49: ground-floor alcove bed removed; teleport up to your_bed (the inn's only bed now) since the specific bed is incidental to this test -- the subject is the unconditional actions_since_sleep reset to 0 + phase_changed firing even day->day (M7 doc comment). Then interact triggers sleep(), and a return teleport to the inn re-renders the inn's own day mood grade so the ui_mood_applied{map:inn,phase:day} wait below still observes it.

THE PRESENCE FLIP, present half (issue #80 item 3): sleep resets the phase clock to day, so hungry_patron's present_when gate is met again -- both proofs run in reverse. Teleport to (5,5) again (forces a fresh rebuild via the same same-map-teleport MAP_CHANGED mechanism).
